title: filter: non-ASCII before/after value panics the server (byte slicing in try_rfc3339_to_epoch_secs)
description: src/filter.rs:415-458 slices by byte index after only a length check; UTCDate deserializes unvalidated. emailPush filter {"before":"202é-01-02T03:04:05Z"} is stored, then every delivery panics inside the memory lock; memory Email/query uses the same evaluator. Must reject as invalidProperties / invalidArguments, never panic. (review 2026-11-19, probe-confirmed) (mail-server review 2026-11-19)
close_reason: Fixed with regression tests (tests/email_query_filter.rs, emailpush_validate.rs, emailpush_deliver.rs).
